title: Person: Stephen

This passage is marked in the Open Editions semantic edition as a person name.

Stephen

anchor.prefix:
They had a different father and mother. They were Eileen’s father and mother. When they were grown up he was going to marry Eileen. He hid under the table. His mother said:

 —O,
anchor.suffix:
will apologise.

 Dante said:

 —O, if not, the eagles will come and pull out his eyes.—

 Pull out his eyes,
